jobs.title: Cloud Automation Solution Architecture (Self Driving)
jobs.desc: Design and build a shared automation test framework and supporting tooling for cloud products (API, integration and end-to-end testing).
jobs.keywords: cloud automation solution architecture self driving python java javascript typescript kubernetes docker terraform aws azure gcp jenkins gitlab ci/cd

duties: Design and build a shared automation test framework and supporting tooling for cloud products (API, integration and end-to-end testing).
Integrate the framework into CI/CD pipelines to give development teams fast, reliable automated testing.
Define test automation standards, patterns and best practices across the organization.
Lead, coach and grow the team of automation engineers.
Work with development teams to drive framework adoption and raise automation maturity.

requirements.title: Technical
items: 8+ years of experience in software engineering or test automation engineering, with strong programming skills in at least one mainstream language (Java, Python, Go or TypeScript/JavaScript).
Have designed and built a test automation framework from scratch (not just written test scripts on top of an existing one).
Proficient with automation tools at every layer:
API/service testing: REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or equivalent
UI/E2E testing: Playwright, Selenium or Cypress
Unit tests/test runners: JUnit/TestNG, pytest or Jest
Contract testing: Pact or equivalent
Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling
Environments/integration: Testcontainers, WireMock/mock servers
Solid grasp of testing strategy for distributed systems and microservices: the test pyramid, API testing, integration and contract testing, mocking/stubbing and test data management.
Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and with building automated testing into them.

Familiar with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP): skilled at testing cloud-hosted services and at using core services (compute, storage, queues, managed databases, IAM) in test setups.
Solid knowledge of cloud-native technologies: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent).
Experience keeping tests reliable at scale: parallel runs, environment isolation and flaky test management.

requirements.title: AI & modern tooling
items: Hands-on experience applying AI to test automation: AI-driven test generation and maintenance (self-healing locators, visual testing), or using LLM tools to speed up test writing and code review.
Fluent with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude or similar) in daily work, and able to set standards for using them effectively and safely across the team.
Knowing how to test AI-powered features (non-deterministic output, prompt/response validation) is a plus.

requirements.title: Leadership & soft skills
items: 5+ years of experience leading or mentoring engineers; able to set technical direction and review other people's work.
Able to drive adoption across multiple teams through communication, coaching and stakeholder management.
A pragmatic product mindset for internal tooling: build what teams will actually use.

requirements.title: Nice to have
items: Experience in platform engineering, developer experience (DevEx) or engineering productivity teams.
Experience automating performance/load testing or security testing.
Experience in an organization moving from manual QA to developers owning test automation.

jobs.title: Lead Fullstack Engineer (BSS)
jobs.desc: Lead the technical direction and make architectural decisions for one or more product teams.
jobs.keywords: lead fullstack engineer cloud python golang reactjs vuejs node.js kubernetes docker linux aws azure gcp mysql ci/cd

duties: Lead the technical direction and make architectural decisions for one or more product teams.
Work with teammates to build new features (coding, unit, integration and end-to-end tests, code review and DevOps deployment) following Scrum practices.
Support and maintain live systems, verify bugs and resolve incidents. Monitor system health and overall SLAs, and take action or escalate when needed.
Work with the Architect to shape the overall architecture and design of the application.
Keep documentation up to date with the latest state of the system, including its logic and functionality.
Review architecture designs and the acceptance criteria of key requirements. Take part in functional requirement analysis and design to improve solutions and how the system is built.
Work with Product Owners/Business Analysts and other stakeholders to turn business requirements into technical solutions.
Break complex features down into smaller tasks and give accurate technical estimates.
Make sure high-quality features ship on schedule.
Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks.
Mentor and coach engineers and team members on technical skills.
Do code reviews and give constructive feedback to raise code quality.
Lead technical discussions and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
Identify skill gaps in the team and build development plans to close them.

requirements.title: Requirements
items: 8+ years of hands-on software development experience.
Expert-level skills in building modern web applications with ReactJS or Vue.
Strong experience with backend languages: NodeJS, Golang or Python.
Experience writing unit tests (Jest) and practicing Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Deep understanding of RESTful API design, GraphQL and design patterns (SOLID, DDD, CQRS…).
Extensive experience with distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture.
Experience with source control, build systems, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience working with and tuning relational databases (MySQL) or NoSQL databases.
Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application security.
Proficient with Linux (Ubuntu/CentOS) and web servers (Nginx/Apache).
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure
Work effectiveness & soft skills
Strong leadership skills, able to guide and influence engineering teams.
Excellent communication skills: able to explain complex technical concepts to many different audiences.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (CDC)
jobs.desc: Assess the current state of the customer's Kubernetes systems, applications and CI/CD pipelines.
jobs.keywords: devops engineer cdc python kubernetes docker terraform ansible openstack ceph linux redis kafka prometheus grafana jenkins gitlab ci/cd

duties: Assess the current state of the customer's Kubernetes systems, applications and CI/CD pipelines.

Design new application architectures on FPT Smart Cloud that fit the customer's existing systems: FKE, Ingress Controller, Load Balancer, API Gateway, registries (Quay, Harbor, Nexus), software-defined storage (NFS, Ceph, Longhorn…), CNI, CSI.
Plan, deploy and migrate manifests (StatefulSet, Deployment, Secret, ConfigMap, CRD…) following the GitOps model (ArgoCD, FluxCD).
Deploy or migrate middleware stacks (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis…), or integrate Kubernetes applications with the PaaS solutions offered by FPT Smart Cloud.
Plan and carry out data migration with PV backup & restore (Velero, Restic, Kasten K10 (Veeam), Trilio).
Set up or migrate CI/CD pipelines in the new environment: SCM, SCA, SAST, DAST, container image scanning.
Build in security and harden the Kubernetes infrastructure: K8s hardening (CIS), runtime security (Falco), Network Policy, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd).
Set up monitoring, logging and alerting for the infrastructure and applications after migration: FMON, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK, Alertmanager or equivalent.
Provide on-call support and work with internal teams and customers to investigate and fix issues during the hypercare period.
Write design documents, migration procedures, test scenarios, operations runbooks and handover guides for customers.

requirements.title: Must-have skills
items: Kubernetes: solid grasp of the architecture and core objects (Deployment, StatefulSet, Service, Ingress, PV/PVC, RBAC, Network Policy); fluent with kubectl and Helm.
Containers: Docker/containerd, writing optimized Dockerfiles, managing image registries.
CI/CD: design and run pipelines with at least one tool: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Tekton or equivalent.
GitOps: hands-on experience with ArgoCD or FluxCD, managing configuration declaratively.
Observability: deploy and use Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager, centralize logs with Loki or ELK, and build dashboards and alerts for systems after migration.
Post-migration testing: plan and run validation tests (functional, performance/load testing with k6/JMeter or equivalent, HA/failover testing) and assess the results against the baseline.
Linux & scripting: strong Linux administration, Bash and/or Python scripting for automation.
Git: fluent with Git workflows (branching, merge requests, reviews).
Pipeline security basics: image scanning (Trivy or equivalent), secret management (no hardcoded credentials), understanding of TLS/certificates.
Networking fundamentals: load balancers, DNS, proxies and firewalls for application deployment.

requirements.title: Nice-to-have skills
items: Experience using self-service offerings in public cloud environments.
Experience deploying Kubernetes on cloud and virtualization platforms: OpenStack, VMware (vSphere, Tanzu, VCD/VCF), KVM.
Experience deploying SDS solutions (Ceph, Longhorn, NFS).
Understanding of VMware and KVM virtualization environments.
Workload migration/backup tools: Velero, Restic, Kasten K10.
Tracing/APM: Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, Elastic APM, Apache SkyWalking
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible.
Advanced secret management: HashiCorp Vault; policy engines: OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno.
Service mesh: Istio/Linkerd.
Registries: Harbor, Nexus, Quay.
Keycloak/SSO/OIDC.
Certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS.
Good English reading and communication skills.

jobs.desc: Gather, analyze and clarify business requirements from customers, partners or internal departments.

Work with architects, developers and QA to make sure the product is built to requirements.
Help build business flows, screen mockups, use cases and user stories.
Run user acceptance testing (UAT) and support system rollout.

Experience analyzing data and business processes in large-scale systems (telecom or finance preferred).
Able to write clear, logical and easy-to-follow documentation.
Good communication, presentation and analytical skills.

requirements.title: Nice to have

Manage systems: VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vCloud) and virtual machines (lifecycle, performance, resources)
Help operate, scale and optimize the Cloud Desktop (Horizon VDI) system.
Deploy and operate system services: AD, DNS, NTP, DHCP, web servers
Troubleshoot incidents across layers: OS, virtualization, network, application

Explore and apply scripting, automation and AI to streamline operations.

At least 2 years of experience in system/infrastructure operations.
Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi and vCenter
Linux experience: installation, configuration, operations, troubleshooting, service, log and performance management
Solid understanding and operation of TCP/IP, AD, DNS, DHCP
Able to use scripting, automation and AI: Bash/Shell, PowerShell, Python (basic)…
Experience with or knowledge of VMware Horizon (VDI); able to operate OpenStack
Have worked with medium-to-large Cloud, Hybrid Cloud or Data Center systems.
